rationale: The workflow is a single, fast, bounded job that only runs a grep-based CRLF line-ending check on ubuntu-latest. It installs no dependencies, has no matrix, no build/test steps, and no long-running step (historical runs complete in about 11 seconds). I evaluated the applicable evidence patterns: P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT does not meaningfully help because the job is already short and bounded, so a timeout would not reduce normal runtime and there is no evidence of runaway runs; P-LIT-GHA-CACHE does not apply because nothing is installed or fetched to cache; P-LIT-FAIL-FAST does not apply because there is no matrix; P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE and P-LIT-SKIP-WORKFLOW are ci_service/contract-level changes rather than workflow-only changes and carry required-check safety concerns. No supported optimization fits this workflow while preserving its intended coverage, so no change is warranted.
